user.title: Sign in with SingleKey ID
user.description:
1. Open DevTools in your browser (F12) on the **Network** tab and enable **Preserve log / Persist Logs**.
2. Open [this SingleKey ID login link]({login_url}) in that tab and sign in (password or passkey).
3. The browser will then fail to open an `idsmobileapp://` address. In the Network list, select the `idpresponse` request (status 302) and copy its **Location** response header. Firefox may also show it in the address bar.
4. Paste the whole `idsmobileapp://?code=...` value below within 5 minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Bosch EasyAir again
reauth_confirm.description:
Your EasyAir session has expired.

1. Open DevTools (F12) on the **Network** tab with **Preserve log / Persist Logs** enabled.
2. Open [this SingleKey ID login link]({login_url}) and sign in.
3. Copy the **Location** header of the `idpresponse` request (it starts with `idsmobileapp://?code=`) and paste it below.

error.invalid_auth: That code was rejected. Codes are single-use and expire after 5 minutes; a new login link has been generated above, please try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EasyAir cloud.

abort.already_configured: This EasyAir account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different account than the one being re-authenticated.
